test_name: Asesor IA responde en UI desktop y conserva acceso mobile
objective: Determine root cause of FAIL_APP_ERROR in test 002

test_preconditions.ai_question: Explicá los factores financieros del período con evidencia.

test_steps: Navigate to homepage and click 'Asesor IA' button (lines 78-79)
Find finance-mobile-navigation and verify visible (line 94) - FAILS HERE
Open mobile nav and click AI Advisor (lines 95-96)

failures.failure_reason: AI returned malformed response - claim-5 contained values not present in cited sources (100.00%)
failures.observable_symptom: The page showed an alert: 'La afirmación claim-5 contiene valores no presentes en sus fuentes citadas: 100.00%' but the ai-advisor-response container was not rendered

failures.failure_reason: Test tries to find finance-mobile-navigation element without first opening the mobile Sheet. The SheetContent is only in DOM when mobileOpen state is true.
failures.observable_symptom: Page snapshot shows no finance-mobile-navigation element - it's a Radix UI Sheet component that unmounts when closed

failures.failure_point: line 80 - ai-advisor-section not visible after clicking button
failures.failure_reason: Navigation to AI advisor section did not complete - possibly due to AI advisor initialization failure
failures.observable_symptom: Clicked 'Asesor IA' button but ai-advisor-section never appeared within 30s

finding_1.description: finance-mobile-navigation test assumes element is always visible in mobile viewport
finding_1.details: finance-mobile-navigation is a Radix UI SheetContent component. It only exists in DOM when Sheet is open (mobileOpen=true). The test does NOT open the sheet before checking visibility.
finding_1.evidence: header.tsx line 67: <SheetContent side='left' data-testid='finance-mobile-navigation'>. Sheet controlled by mobileOpen state at line 61: <Sheet open={mobileOpen}>.
finding_1.fix_required: Test must click the hamburger menu button (SheetTrigger) BEFORE checking finance-mobile-navigation visibility

finding_2.description: AI advisor returns malformed responses causing UI rendering failure
finding_2.details: The AI model (gemma4:31b-cloud) sometimes returns claims with values not present in cited sources, triggering validation errors that prevent ai-advisor-response container from rendering
finding_2.evidence: Attempt 1 error context: 'La afirmación claim-5 contiene valores no presentes en sus fuentes citadas: 100.00%' - response was received but validation failed
finding_2.fix_required: Application should handle malformed AI responses gracefully, or AI model/prompt should be adjusted to prevent invalid claims

finding_3.description: AI advisor section navigation sometimes fails to complete
finding_3.details: When clicking 'Asesor IA' button, the section sometimes doesn't appear within 30s timeout - possibly due to AI advisor initialization or context loading issues
finding_3.evidence: Attempt 3 failed at line 80 - ai-advisor-section not visible after clicking button
finding_3.fix_required: Investigate why AI advisor section doesn't load - could be initialization race condition or error handling issue

root_cause_classification: MIXED - test defect (finance-mobile-navigation) + application defects (AI advisor nondeterministic behavior)

test_fix.description: Open the mobile Sheet before checking finance-mobile-navigation visibility
test_fix.code_change: Add before line 94: await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Abrir menú' }).click(); await expect(mobileNav).toBeVisible();
test_fix.impact: Will make test deterministic for the mobile navigation check

application_fix_ai_response.description: Handle malformed AI responses more gracefully in the UI
application_fix_ai_response.details: When AI returns claims with validation errors, the UI should still display the response container with an error message instead of silently failing to render
application_fix_ai_response.impact: Will make test more robust but underlying AI issue remains

hypothesis_vs_facts.hypothesis_from_previous_run: Backend was crashing during AI advisor tests
hypothesis_vs_facts.fact_demonstrated: Backend does NOT crash - PID 9856 survived all 3 attempts with health 200 throughout. Previous failures were due to Python harness issues, not backend stability.
hypothesis_vs_facts.new_finding: Test failures are due to AI advisor nondeterministic behavior and test defect, not backend stability
